EULER PLOTS (variance partitioning)

# Helper that builds a named vector for
# euler() from a varpart output df
build_euler_set <- function(varpart_df, dist_name,
    taxon) {
    df <- varpart_df %>%
        filter(distance == dist_name & tax ==
            taxon) %>%
        dplyr::select(variable, percent)

    c(R = df[8, 2], `R&host` = df[1, 2], `R&diet` = df[2,
        2], `R&geo` = df[3, 2], `R&host&diet` = df[4,
        2], `R&diet&geo` = df[5, 2], `R&host&geo` = df[6,
        2], `R&host&diet&geo` = df[7, 2])
}

# Helper that plots an Euler diagram with
# the standard styling
plot_euler <- function(euler_set, title_str = "Species") {
    fit <- euler(euler_set, input = "disjoint",
        shape = "ellipse")

    set_colors <- c(R = "white", host = "#a00000",
        diet = "#000000", geo = "#59a89c")

    # average two or more hex colours in RGB
    # space
    blend <- function(cols, amount = 0.25) {
        rgbs <- col2rgb(cols)/255
        avg <- rowMeans(rgbs)
        lit <- avg + (1 - avg) * amount
        rgb(lit["red"], lit["green"], lit["blue"])
    }

    p <- plot(fit, fills = list(fill = set_colors),
        quantities = FALSE, labels = list(labels = c("",
            "", "", ""), cex = 1))

    region_names <- names(fit$fitted.values)
    diag_grob <- p$children$canvas.grob$children$diagram.grob.1

    for (i in seq_along(region_names)) {
        nm <- paste0("fills.grob.", i)
        g <- diag_grob$children[[nm]]
        if (is.null(g) || is.null(g$gp))
            next

        sets <- strsplit(region_names[i], "&")[[1]]
        non_R <- setdiff(sets, "R")

        if (length(non_R) == 0) {
            g$gp$fill <- "white"
        } else if (length(non_R) == 1) {
            g$gp$fill <- unname(set_colors[non_R])
        } else {
            g$gp$fill <- blend(unname(set_colors[non_R]))
        }

        diag_grob$children[[nm]] <- g
    }
    p$children$canvas.grob$children$diagram.grob.1 <- diag_grob

    gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = list(p), top = textGrob(title_str,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 16)))
}
# At Species level (used in main figure)
species_bray_set <- build_euler_set(varpart_out,
    "Bray-Curtis", "Species")
species_jacc_set <- build_euler_set(varpart_out,
    "Jaccard", "Species")

euler_bray <- plot_euler(species_bray_set, "Species")

euler_jacc <- plot_euler(species_jacc_set, "Species")

VARPART BARPLOTS

# Collapse overlap categories
varpart_out$variable2 <- gsub(".*_.*", "overlap",
    varpart_out$variable)

ind_sum <- varpart_out %>%
    group_by(pop_ind, distance, tax, variable2) %>%
    summarise(percent2 = sum(percent), .groups = "drop")

ind_sum$order <- factor(ind_sum$variable2, levels = c("host",
    "diet", "geo", "overlap", "Unexplained"),
    labels = c("Phylogeny", "Diet", "Geography",
        "Overlap", "Unexplained"))

# Colour palette tied to the levels
varpart_colors <- c(Phylogeny = "#a00000", Diet = "#000000",
    Geography = "#59a89c", Overlap = "lightgrey",
    Unexplained = "white")

ind_sum$tax <- factor(ind_sum$tax, levels = c("OTU99",
    "Species", "Genus", "Family", "Order", "Class",
    "Phylum"))

(varPar <- ggplot(ind_sum, aes(y = tax, x = percent2,
    fill = order)) + geom_bar(position = "stack",
    stat = "identity", linewidth = 0.25, color = "black") +
    geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity",
        linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous("% variance explained",
        limits = c(0, 25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = varpart_colors,
        name = "") + facet_wrap(. ~ factor(distance),
    strip.position = "top", ncol = 2, dir = "v") +
    barplot_theme + theme(legend.position = "right",
    panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#bababa",
        linewidth = 1), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 16),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black",
        size = 0.5), legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16), strip.text = element_text(size = 18)) +
    xlab("% variance explained") + ylab(""))

SUBSAMPLE MICROBIOME (equal sample size per population)

sample_ps <- function(ps, size, FUN = sample) {
    ids <- sample_names(ps)
    prune_samples(FUN(ids, size = size), ps)
}

pop_labels <- levels(factor(sample_data(microb_overlap_species)$Species_Label))

set.seed(999)
subsampled_list <- lapply(pop_labels, function(lbl) {
    # Use prune_samples with logical vector
    # instead of subset_samples to avoid NSE
    keep <- sample_data(microb_overlap_species)$Species_Label ==
        lbl
    ps <- prune_samples(keep, microb_overlap_species)
    if (nrow(sample_data(ps)) >= 9)
        sample_ps(ps, size = 9) else ps
})

microb_fr_subsample_species <- do.call(merge_phyloseq,
    subsampled_list) %>%
    biomeUtils::removeZeros()

MERGE BY POPULATION

ps_merged_species <- phyloseq::merge_samples(microb_fr_subsample_species,

GEOGRAPHIC CENTROIDS

my_points <- data.frame(longitude = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Xdec,
    latitude = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Ydec,
    Island_Mainland = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Species_Label,
    row.names = sample_names(microb_overlap_otu))

df_sf <- st_as_sf(my_points, coords = c("longitude",
    "latitude"))

centroids_sf <- df_sf %>%
    group_by(Island_Mainland) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
    st_centroid() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,
        1], lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 2])

rownames(centroids_sf) <- centroids_sf$Island_Mainland

dist_mat <- distm(cbind(centroids_sf$lon, centroids_sf$lat),
    fun = distGeo)/1000
rownames(dist_mat) <- centroids_sf$Island_Mainland
colnames(dist_mat) <- centroids_sf$Island_Mainland
geo_dist <- as.dist(dist_mat)

DIVERGENCE (individual-level Bray and Jaccard)

# Helper to compute divergence (betadisper
# distance to median) per metric
compute_divergence <- function(ps, method, binary = FALSE,
    name) {
    tab <- otu_table(ps)
    d <- vegdist(tab, method = method, binary = binary)
    bd <- betadisper(d, sample_data(ps)$Species_Label,
        type = "median")$distance
    df <- data.frame(beta_median = bd) %>%
        rownames_to_column("TipID_microbiome")
    names(df)[2] <- name
    df
}

bray_div <- compute_divergence(microb_overlap_species,
    "bray", binary = FALSE, "b.beta_median")
jaccard_div <- compute_divergence(microb_overlap_species,
    "jaccard", binary = TRUE, "j.beta_median")

LOAD F_ROH

metadata <- read_delim(paste0(dataDir, "/WGS_Fringilla_samples.tsv"),
    delim = ",")

froh <- read_delim(paste0(dataDir, "/fringilla_microbiome_roh_rg_filtered.csv"),
    delim = ",")
names(froh) <- c("TipID_microbiome", "total_length_bp",
    "froh")

froh_meta <- left_join(froh, metadata, by = "TipID_microbiome")

roh_bray <- left_join(froh_meta, bray_div, by = "TipID_microbiome") %>%
    filter(!is.na(b.beta_median))
roh_jacc <- left_join(froh_meta, jaccard_div,
    by = "TipID_microbiome") %>%
    filter(!is.na(j.beta_median))

F_ROH GLMM AND PLOT

glmm_bray <- glmmTMB(b.beta_median ~ froh + (1 |
    Species_Label), data = roh_bray, na.action = na.fail,
    family = gaussian)
glmm_jacc <- glmmTMB(j.beta_median ~ froh + (1 |
    Species_Label), data = roh_jacc, na.action = na.fail,
    family = gaussian)

effect_bray <- as.data.frame(effect("froh", glmm_bray,
    confint = list(alpha = 0.95))) %>%
    mutate(Distance_name = "Bray")
effect_jac <- as.data.frame(effect("froh", glmm_jacc,
    confint = list(alpha = 0.95))) %>%
    mutate(Distance_name = "Jaccard")
effect_df <- bind_rows(effect_bray, effect_jac)

(p_het <- ggplot(dist_froh_df, aes(y = beta_median,
    x = froh, color = Distance_name)) + geom_point(size = 3,
    alpha = 0.3, colour = "black") + scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred",
    "black")) + xlab(expression(italic("F"[ROH]))) +
    ylab("Divergence") + geom_line(data = effect_df,
    aes(x = froh, y = fit), linewidth = 1.5) +
    geom_ribbon(data = effect_df, aes(x = froh,
        y = fit, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
        alpha = 0.1, colour = NA) + facet_wrap(. ~
    factor(Distance_name), strip.position = "top") +
    fig4_theme + theme(legend.position = "none"))

GLMM F_ROH FOREST PLOT

colnames(glmm_out) <- c("term", "Estimate", "Std_Error",
    "z_value", "P", "lower", "upper", "data",
    "taxonomy", "dist")

glmm_out <- glmm_out %>%
    mutate(order = factor(taxonomy, levels = c("OTU99",
        "species", "genus", "family", "order",
        "class", "phylum"), labels = c("OTU99",
        "Species", "Genus", "Family", "Order",
        "Class", "Phylum")), signif = case_when(P <
        5e-04 ~ "< 0.0005", P < 0.005 ~ "< 0.005",
        P < 0.05 ~ "< 0.05", TRUE ~ "n.s"), term = gsub("[[:digit:]]+",
        "", term))

glmm_fill_colors <- c(`< 0.05` = "#999999", `< 0.005` = "#333333",
    `< 0.0005` = "#000000", n.s = "white")

(p_glmm <- glmm_out %>%
    filter(term == "scale(froh)", data == "all") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = order)) + geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower,
    xmax = upper), linewidth = 1.2, color = "#000000") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = signif), pch = 21, size = 4,
        color = "black") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "longdash") + scale_fill_manual("p-value",
    values = glmm_fill_colors) + xlab("Estimate") +
    ylab("") + facet_wrap(. ~ factor(dist), strip.position = "top") +
    fig4_theme)

VARPART BARPLOT

(varPar <- ggplot(ind_sum, aes(y = tax, x = percent2,
    fill = order)) + geom_bar(position = "stack",
    stat = "identity", linewidth = 0.25, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous("% variance explained",
        limits = c(0, 25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = varpart_colors,
        name = "") + facet_wrap(. ~ factor(distance),
    strip.position = "top", ncol = 2, dir = "v") +
    xlab("% variance explained") + ylab("") +
    fig4_themeB)

COMPOSE FIGURE 4

((varPar + inset_element(euler_bray, 0.3, 0.18,
